the free encyclopedia Australian lawn bowler Jim Yates Personal information Nationality Australia Born ( 1934-10-11 ) 11 October 1934 (age 91) Medal record Representing Australia World Indoor Championships 1988 Men's pairs Jim Yates is a former Australian lawn and indoor bowler and coach, born in Corowa , New South Wales on 11 October 1934. Bowls career [ edit ] Yates partnered Ian Schuback when he won the 1988 World Indoor Bowls Championship Pairs. He won the Australian Singles Championship in 1979 and the Adelaide Masters in 1983, 1984 and 1987. [ 1 ] Additionally he has won ten Club Singles Championships and played 211 games for the Victorian State team. [ 2 ] References [ edit ] ^ Newby, Donald (1987). Daily Telegraph Bowls Yearbook 88 .
